1/ Cash Flow Brief, Nov 14 ☀️

Bitcoin's slide into Extreme Fear, Nvidia's CEO exit and US-China tariff talks are the biggest things for your wallet today.

What happened, why it matters, and what could happen next 🧵

2/ Politics: The US-China trade council met Friday on tariff cuts and farm trade, China said Saturday.

Why it matters: Tariffs can move the prices you pay and the dollar.

Next: If the $60B tariff-cut deal is finalised next week, watch import prices.

3/ CFTC sued Louisiana and Arkansas over prediction-market rules. SEC proposed pay-disclosure reforms Friday. Why it matters: Who regulates prediction markets decides which platforms you can use. Next: If courts side with states, access could shift.

4/ Stocks: Nvidia fell 4.3% Thursday after CEO Jensen Huang resigned. AMD rose 5.9%.

Why it matters: Nvidia is a big slice of many index funds, so your 401(k) feels it.

Next: Watch Nvidia's earnings, due Nov 17 (timing unconfirmed).

5/ Fear & Greed hit 13 (Extreme Fear) as Bitcoin fell below $68,000 on Nov 13. $1.65B liquidated in 24 hours. Why: Bitcoin ETFs: $1.9B net outflows this month. Next: Staying under $68,000 through Sunday's close adds pressure. Not financial advice.
